name: @veritrail/zk-compliance
description: Predicate-level zero-knowledge proofs over the tamper-evident Veritrail ledger. Prove to a counterparty that a property holds (e.g. "no PII leaked outside the EU in Q3") without revealing the underlying events. v0.1 ships verifiable Merkle-style commitments; full SNARK circuits land in v0.2.
